description: Sasso Corbaro stands alone on a rocky hill southeast of Bellinzona, the highest of the three UNESCO castles, with the 1478 northeast tower and a later southwest tower. It is not tied into the town walls. Castelgrande, Montebello, and Parco Ciani are already published. The Open-Meteo model is clear and mild, about 15°C, with no cloud, a breeze, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
